subject: Pricing and commitment follow-up - FinApp discovery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@finapp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps (pricing & commitment)

Hi Samir - great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

Summary of the workflow you described:
- Ingest: customer support transcripts + product logs (~10M messages/month)
- Runtime: reranking + LLM-assisted summarization + embeddings for similarity search
- Typical prompt size: 800-1200 tokens upstream; average response 250-400 tokens downstream

Estimated monthly token volume (ballpark from call):
- Ingest + generation = ~150M-250M tokens/month; spike to ~400M in peak events
- Year 1 forecast (conservative): ~1.8B tokens total

Budget & unit economics we discussed:
- Target unit price target you mentioned: ~$800-$1,200 / 1M tokens (we discussed $/1M tokens rather than per-request pricing to map to embedding and generation costs)
- Your initial budget range for pilot: $8k- $15k/month, with ability to expand after ROI validation

Discount and commitment options (what I can offer):
1) Startup program (if FinApp qualifies) - one-time onboarding credit + 25% off hosted usage for first 6 months (applied monthly). Requires company size / funding criteria; we can confirm with legal.
2) Committed-use tiers (12-month):
   - 1M tokens/day (≈30M/month): 8% discount vs list
   - 5M tokens/day (≈150M/month): 18% discount + priority capacity
   - 15M tokens/day (≈450M/month): 28% discount + lower egress/unit rates + SLA uplift
3) Multi-year incentives - available for 24-month commit, we can stack an additional 5-7% off depending on seat/throughput commitments and payment terms.

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm which discount path you want us to model (startup, 12-month commit, or 24-month).
- If you want a committed-use proposal, confirm target committed tokens/month and preferred billing cadence. I can send a formal commitment quote + DocuSign.
- I've attached a draft pricing sheet and a quick projection workbook for you to review.

If it helps, Ben and Laura are copied - Ben is on discounts & pricing and Laura can help scope an initial SLA for Dedicated if you want to evaluate reserved capacity.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-2027Q2.pdf, finapp-projected-tokens-2027.xlsx

From: Samir Patel <samir@finapp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps (pricing & commitment)

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Startup program: FinApp is an early-stage SaaS with a Seed+ extension; we may qualify (I can share investor/funding info once we sign an NDA). Would that be enough to trigger the 25% startup credit?
2) Token volumes: your conservative estimate aligns with ours (we project ~120-180M tokens/month for the pilot). Ramp to 300-450M/month in Q3 if pilot metrics look good.
3) Budget: our procurement lead signaled a $10k- $20k/mo pilot envelope, but there's flexibility if we commit to a 12-month guaranteed baseline.

Requests: can you model an example quote for these two options?
A) No-commit pilot with startup discount applied for 6 months at ~150M tokens/mo
B) 12-month committed-use at 150M tokens/mo with the 18% discount tier you mentioned (and include the multi-year uplift option for year 2)

Also send over any qualification details you need for the startup program so we can validate quickly. We'd like to move fast on this.

Thanks - Samir
Head of Product | FinApp
samir@finapp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps (pricing & commitment)

Thanks Samir - appreciate the quick answers. Attached are two items: 1) a modeled quote for the two scenarios you requested (No-commit pilot with startup credit for 6 months and a 12-month committed-use offer at the 150M tokens/month level with the 18% discount), and 2) a short checklist for startup program qualification.

Highlights from the modeled quote (top-line):
- Pilot (no commit) @ 150M tokens/mo with 25% startup credit applied for 6 months: estimated $11,200/mo effective in months 1-6, then list rates afterwards.
- 12-month commit @ 150M tokens/mo with 18% committed-use discount: estimated $9,100/mo (annual billing preferred for max incentive).
- If you sign a 24-month commitment and prepay annually we can add an extra 6% off (final blended ~24% off list) - I noted that as a multi-year uplift option in the quote.

Next actions I've put on the table: 
- Samir: confirm which option you want modeled into a formal commitment quote (A or B).
- FinApp (procurement): if choosing startup path, please provide funding docs / investor info for the checklist attached.
- Redwood legal: Ben - can you prepare standard commitment language for the 12-month tier and a DocuSign link for signature once FinApp confirms?

I'll upload the formal quote to the HubSpot deal and send a DocuSign once we have confirmation. Pls let me know if you prefer a quick call tomorrow to run through the numbers live.

Best,
Marissa
